entry.name: Generative AI Fundamentals in Python
entry.note: A short project-based path with a completion certificate, not a proctored exam
entry.audience: Developers who want hands-on practice with LLM APIs

covers: Python syntax, variables, loops, data structures and conditionals
Dictionaries, functions and using APIs to retrieve data
Object oriented programming, decorators, regular expressions and error handling
Command line tools, virtual environments and Git
APIs and web scraping for AI applications
Prompt engineering and the OpenAI Chat Completions API
Managing conversation history and token usage
Building interactive web apps with Streamlit
reading.format: The path is split into three parts containing eight courses in total, with interactive lessons, hands on exercises and projects. Projects include a food ordering app, a text based Garden Simulator, a Sassy Chatbot with a Streamlit interface, and an AI chatbot built with the OpenAI API. A certificate is awarded on completion.
reading.summary: This is a Dataquest skill path that teaches Python programming alongside generative AI work. Learners start with Python basics, then move to APIs, intermediate Python, and finally to using large language models in code. The path ends with building AI powered applications, including chatbots with a Streamlit interface. Completing it earns a certificate that can be added to a resume or LinkedIn profile.
reading.audience: The page says the path is designed for anyone who wants to bring AI capabilities into their work, and calls it essential for professionals who want AI in their toolkit.
